note: Classification groups in graph: a lone edition with no chain draws nothing; a curated group draws its members under its key and label, and a member's chain (sunx-a0 precedes sunx-a) ungrouped; an edition that is not a member draws the groups of the editions on its chain, giving its successor, first drawn ungrouped, the group's key. Fails if the empty-graph rule draws a lone edition, if a member reached first keeps no group key, or if graph adds only the focus's own groups (an older SUN edition then lost its family, #1299).
